name: Fictional Public Oversight & Statutory Compulsion Rules

rules.name: Statutory Regulatory Compulsion Power
rules.description: Statutory power of regulator and investigator to compel records from regulated entities, requiring an active warrant/order.

rules.name: Immunity of Regulatory Board Against Subpoena
rules.description: Regulated entities and private parties are strictly prohibited from attempting to compel records from the regulatory board.

rules.name: Statutory Audit Disclosure Duty
rules.description: Licensees and auditors have an affirmative legal duty to disclose completed audit records to the oversight authorities.

rules.name: Mandatory Record Retention for Oversight
rules.description: Statutory duty of regulators, investigators, and operating licensees to preserve and retain regulatory records.
